# Design: Admin Panel — Option A (Integrated)

**Generated by:** cm-planning (revised after decision change)
**Date:** 2026-04-11
**Decision change:** Separate SPA → Integrated into main app at `/admin/*`

---

## Context & Technical Approach

### Why Option A

| | Option B (Separate SPA) | Option A (Integrated) ✅ |
|---|---|---|
| Effort | ~6h | ~3h |
| Design tokens | Must copy from scratch | Already in `src/index.css` |
| Supabase client | Duplicated in 2 projects | Shared single `src/lib/supabase.ts` |
| Deploy | 2 separate Cloudflare sites | 1 site, `/admin/*` route-guarded |
| Auth | Separate Supabase Auth | Shared Supabase Auth |

**Option A wins** vì user làm một mình, cần tốc độ, và admin chỉ dùng bởi 1 người.

### How It Works

```
main app (same Vite build — single Cloudflare Pages deploy)
├── /              → LandingPage (public)
├── /login         → LoginPage (public — Supabase email auth)
├── /dashboard     → DashboardPage (auth required)
├── /study         → StudyPage (auth required)
├── /library       → LibraryPage (auth required)
├── /admin         → AdminDashboardPage (admin role required)
├── /admin/words   → AdminWordsPage (admin role required)
├── /admin/topics  → AdminTopicsPage (admin role required)
├── /admin/roadmaps → AdminRoadmapsPage (admin role required)
└── /admin/users   → AdminUsersPage (admin role required)
```

---

## Architecture

```
src/
├── lib/
│   ├── supabase.ts        ← TẠO: Supabase client singleton
│   ├── auth.ts            ← TẠO: signIn / signUp / signOut / getSession
│   ├── srs.ts             ✅ existing
│   ├── storage.ts         ✅ existing (phase 10 mới thay)
│   └── streak.ts          ✅ existing
├── contexts/
│   └── AuthContext.tsx    ← TẠO: useAuth() hook
├── components/
│   ├── Sidebar.tsx        ← CẬP NHẬT: hardcoded user → useAuth()
│   ├── AdminLayout.tsx    ← TẠO: sidebar layout cho /admin/*
│   └── AdminSidebar.tsx   ← TẠO: admin nav links
├── pages/
│   ├── LoginPage.tsx      ← TẠO: Supabase email auth
│   ├── AdminDashboardPage.tsx  ← TẠO
│   ├── AdminWordsPage.tsx ← TẠO
│   ├── AdminTopicsPage.tsx ← TẠO
│   ├── AdminRoadmapsPage.tsx ← TẠO
│   └── AdminUsersPage.tsx ← TẠO
└── App.tsx                ← CẬP NHẬT: thêm routes + AuthProvider
```

---

## Data Flow

### Phase 1–8 (Admin Panel + Student Auth — no student sync yet)

```
Admin action → supabase.from('words').insert() → RLS check → DB
Student signup → Supabase Auth → auto-create user_profiles (trigger)
Student login → AuthContext → redirect /dashboard
```

Student app **vẫn dùng localStorage** trong phase 1–8. Chỉ admin pages ghi Supabase.

### Phase 9 (Seed data)

```
sampleCards[] (15 cards từ storage.ts)
→ INSERT roadmaps → topics → words → word_choices
→ Via Supabase MCP (one-time)
→ OR via Admin UI sau khi AdminWordsPage xong
```

### Phase 10 (Student → Supabase Sync)

```
loadCards() + loadProgress() (localStorage)
→ thay bằng supabase.from('words').select('*, topics(*), word_choices(*)')
→ thay saveProgress() bằng supabase.from('user_progress').upsert()
→ useFlashcard hook becomes async
```

---

## Schema Mapping: Old Card → New Words

### Old localStorage `Card`:
```ts
{ id: string, front: string, back: string, example?: string, topic: string }
```

### New Supabase `words`:
```ts
{ id: uuid, topic_id: uuid, word: string, phonetic: string,
  pos: string, difficulty: 1-5, definition: string, example: string,
  example_vi: string, created_at: timestamptz }
```

### Seed plan (Phase 9):
| localStorage field | → Supabase field |
|---|---|
| `front` | `word` |
| `back` | `definition` |
| `example` | `example` |
| `topic` string | → `topic_id` (lookup by slug) |
| 3 wrong choices | Auto-generate from other words' definitions |

## Auth Guard Logic

```typescript
// src/lib/auth.ts
export function requireAdmin(user: User | null): asserts user is User {
  if (!user) throw new Error('AUTH_REQUIRED')
  // Client-side check (full check server-side via RLS)
}

// src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx
// Provider wraps App
// useAuth() returns: { user, session, loading, isAdmin, signIn, signOut }
```

**Note:** `apps/admin/src/lib/auth-guard.ts` — stub đó vẫn giữ nguyên, KHÔNG dùng nữa vì chọn Option A.
